scoreMethodology.score100Meaning: current growth from seed equals historical average growth from seed at jackpot hit
scoreMethodology.score300Meaning: current growth from seed is three times historical average hit growth
scoreMethodology.type1Assumption: jackpot hit probability is independent of current jackpot value
scoreMethodology.dynamicScoreForSparseHistory: when insufficient hit data, current jackpot may be hypothetically added as a hit to prevent artificially high score
scoreMethodology.sparseHistoryWarning: terms state that with only a few hits, e.g. fewer than 10, SCORE may substantially differ from the real value

probabilityCurveTaxonomy.sourceClaim: Wizard of POTS constructs hit-distribution/probability charts and distinguishes jackpot types rather than treating every progressive as Type 1.
probabilityCurveTaxonomy.edgeInterpretation: This is a useful world benchmark for empirical hazard-shape classification. EDGE must independently identify mechanism and censoring before fitting any curve.

strengthsToMatchOrExceed: normalization of current jackpot growth versus historical hits
attempted current RTP estimates when RTP/contribution inputs are known
scientificLimitationsForEdgeExecution: SCORE depends on historical average hit value and seed being comparable to the current configuration.
A high SCORE is a payout-growth descriptor, not by itself a verified positive-EV threshold.
The Type 1 RTP scaling formula is valid only if the jackpot event probability is constant with jackpot size and the historical sample represents the same configuration.
Estimated RTP inherits errors from seed, contribution, base RTP, jackpot hit history and configuration changes.
A current value near or above historical average hit does not mean the jackpot is due.
A drop-detected historical hit still needs award/configuration attribution for EDGE-grade evidence.
Cross-market and cross-operator histories cannot be transferred into Spain execution without exact configuration identity.

adopt: normalized jackpot-growth score as a research-only descriptive feature
current RTP calculation only when exact inputs permit it
improve: 5-second Spain canonical feed instead of ~5-minute update target where public feed allows
candidate reset versus verified award distinction
durable observed ATH with exact timestamps
full observed cycles between candidate boundaries
confidence bounds rather than point-estimate promotion
fail-closed execution contract with exact game/stake/budget/expiry

researchOnlyScorePolicy.name: EDGE_GROWTH_SCORE
allowedOnlyIf: seed/reset belongs to same current configuration
historical awards are verified awards rather than candidate drops
configuration remained comparable over the fitted history
sample size and censoring are reported
researchOnlyScorePolicy.reason: Growth normalization can prioritize research but cannot substitute for a verified hazard/EV model.

measurableWorldClassBar.coverage: ultimately track every publicly observable Spain progressive plus high-value global controls
measurableWorldClassBar.cadence: target <=5 seconds for Botemania canonical feed; record actual cadence/gaps per source
measurableWorldClassBar.history: retain exact observed ATH, cycles, resets, configuration periods and long-horizon aggregates
measurableWorldClassBar.identity: no statistic may silently merge different market/operator/tier/configuration identities
measurableWorldClassBar.uncertainty: every threshold/model reports sample size, censoring, confidence/model assumptions and validation status
measurableWorldClassBar.execution: only the fail-closed execution contract can produce GREEN
